content.user_title: Transform Source Material into Social Posts
content.value_statement: Creating platform-ready content from one source takes time and can cause inconsistent messaging. This skill organizes original social post drafts while preserving attribution and source accuracy.
actual_capabilities: Identifies the source audience, key points, evidence, links, ownership, and desired outcome.
Plans varied hooks, summaries, questions, carousels, video concepts, and calls to action.
Guides adaptation of content for different social platforms.
Preserves attribution and canonical links where they are relevant.
Prepares content as drafts, scheduled-post plans, or CSV and API execution plans.
Instructs the model not to invent quotations, statistics, transcripts, or media.
limitations: It depends on source material and facts supplied by the user.
It does not verify claims, ownership, permissions, or legal compliance.
It does not publish content or operate BulkPublish directly.
Platform requirements and audience preferences still require user review.

use_cases.title: Extend an article campaign
use_cases.description: Create a coordinated set of social post drafts from a published article while retaining its key evidence and link.

use_cases.title: Reuse newsletter insights
use_cases.description: Turn a newsletter into distinct post ideas, discussion questions, and calls to action for multiple channels.

use_cases.title: Plan transcript-based posts
use_cases.description: Extract supported ideas from an interview or webinar transcript and plan short-form post and video concepts.

prompt_templates.title: Create basic post drafts
prompt_templates.prompt: Repurpose this article into five original social post drafts. State the source link in each draft where appropriate: [paste article].

prompt_templates.title: Build a varied content package
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this newsletter and create a varied social package with hooks, summaries, questions, and calls to action. Use only claims supported by the source: [paste newsletter].

prompt_templates.title: Adapt for selected channels
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this transcript into platform-native drafts for LinkedIn, X, and Instagram. Preserve attribution, flag unsupported details, and include the canonical link where relevant: [paste transcript].

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an execution plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a review-ready BulkPublish execution plan from this announcement. Include draft text, recommended formats, asset needs, schedule suggestions, and any missing source information: [paste announcement].

output_examples.input: A product announcement describing a new reporting feature with one customer quote and a launch date.
output: LinkedIn draft that explains the reporting benefit and links to the announcement.
Short post that highlights the launch date without repeating the customer quote.
Carousel outline that separates supported feature details into clear slides.

output_examples.input: A webinar transcript about improving editorial planning.
output: Five evidence-based post ideas with distinct hooks.
Two short-form video concepts that identify needed footage.
A list of transcript claims that need review before publication.

best_practices: Provide the full source, canonical link, audience, and campaign goal.
Review every draft for accuracy, attribution, permissions, and platform requirements.
Use varied formats and hooks so posts add value instead of repeating the source.
anti_patterns: Do not request invented quotations, statistics, transcript wording, or media.
Do not copy large sections of the source into every post.
Do not publish drafts without confirming ownership, links, and factual claims.

faq.question: What source materials can I use?
faq.answer: You can provide an article, newsletter, transcript, announcement, or similar material.

faq.question: Does the skill create original posts?
faq.answer: It guides creation of original, platform-native drafts based on supported source ideas.

faq.question: Can it publish posts for me?
faq.answer: No. It prepares drafts or execution plans, but it does not publish content.

faq.question: How does it handle attribution?
faq.answer: It instructs the model to preserve attribution and canonical links where relevant.

faq.question: Can it create image or video plans?
faq.answer: Yes. It can plan derived media needs, but it does not create unsupported media.

faq.question: Should I review the results?
faq.answer: Yes. Review facts, permissions, links, brand voice, and platform requirements before use.
